from semver import compare, sort_versions, _parse_version, _version_key

# === Temel karşılaştırmalar ===
assert compare("1.2.3", "2.3.4") == -1
assert compare("1.2.3", "1.2.3") == 0
assert compare("2.3.4", "1.2.3") == 1

# === MAJOR / MINOR / PATCH sıralaması ===
assert compare("1.0.0", "2.0.0") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0", "1.1.0") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0", "1.0.1") == -1

# === Ön sürümler ===
# No-pre > all-pre
assert compare("1.0.0", "1.0.0-alpha") == 1
assert compare("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha.1") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0-alpha.1", "1.0.0-alpha.beta") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0-alpha.beta", "1.0.0-beta") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-beta.2") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0-beta.2", "1.0.0-beta.11") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0-beta.11", "1.0.0-rc.1") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0-rc.1", "1.0.0") == -1

# Build versions don't affect precedence
assert compare("1.0.0+build.1", "1.0.0+build.2") == 0
assert compare("1.0.0-alpha+build", "1.0.0-alpha") == 0

# === v prefix ===
assert compare("v1.2.3", "1.2.3") == 0
assert compare("v1.0.0", "v2.0.0") == -1

# === Numeric prerelease comparison ===
assert compare("1.0.0-1", "1.0.0-2") == -1
assert compare("1.0.0-2", "1.0.0-10") == -1  # numeric, not lexicographic

# === Leading zeros ===
try:
    _parse_version("1.01.0")
    assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
except ValueError:
    pass

try:
    _parse_version("01.0.0")
    assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
except ValueError:
    pass

try:
    _parse_version("0.0.01")
    assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
except ValueError:
    pass

# === 0.0.0 is valid ===
assert compare("0.0.0", "0.0.0") == 0

# === Invalid inputs ===
for bad in ["", "1.2", "1.2.3.4", "abc", "1.2.3-beta-", "1.2.3-", "+build"]:
    try:
        _parse_version(bad)
        assert False, f"Should have raised ValueError for {bad!r}"
    except ValueError:
        pass

# === sort_versions ===
versions = [
    "1.0.0-alpha",
    "1.0.0",
    "1.0.0-alpha.1",
    "1.0.0-beta.2",
    "1.0.0-beta.11",
    "1.0.0-rc.1",
]
sorted_v = sort_versions(versions)
expected = [
    "1.0.0-alpha",
    "1.0.0-alpha.1",
    "1.0.0-beta.2",
    "1.0.0-beta.11",
    "1.0.0-rc.1",
    "1.0.0",
]
assert sorted_v == expected, f"Got {sorted_v}"

# === Build info ignored in sorting ===
assert sort_versions(["1.0.0+aaa", "1.0.0+zzz"]) == ["1.0.0+aaa", "1.0.0+zzz"]

# === Stable sort: equal precedence keeps original order ===
versions_stable = ["1.0.0+a", "1.0.0+b"]
result = sort_versions(versions_stable)
assert result == ["1.0.0+a", "1.0.0+b"], f"Stable sort failed: {result}"

# === Numeric prerelease vs alphanumeric ===
assert compare("1.0.0-1", "1.0.0-alpha") == -1  # numeric < alpha

print("Tüm testler geçti!")
